description: Stock/out-of-stock system + orders page showing all orders + conditional payment heading + buy-now cleanup. These are independent of FEAT-001 (different files) and can be implemented in any order relative to FEAT-001, but are grouped together because they all touch the customer purchase/order flow.
steps: Step 1 — H-3 stock check in priceOrder: Edit lib/order-pricing.ts. In the lines = parsed.map(...) callback, after 'const product = dbProducts.find((p) => p.id === item.baseId);' and the 'if (!product) throw' guard, add: if (product.stock !== null && product.stock < item.quantity) { throw new Error(`"${product.name}" is currently out of stock or has insufficient stock to fill your order.`); }. This throws server-side during payment creation, preventing overselling.

Step 2 — H-4 out-of-stock UI in product-detail-view.tsx: Edit components/product/product-detail-view.tsx. Add after the existing constant declarations (after 'const hasDiscount = ...'): const isOutOfStock = typeof product.stock === 'number' && product.stock <= 0; Then: (a) In the price-section div, if isOutOfStock is true, add a badge element: Out of Stock. (b) On the Add to Cart button: change disabled={isAdded} to disabled={isAdded || isOutOfStock} and update the button text to show 'Out of Stock' when isOutOfStock (take precedence over 'Add to Cart'/'✓ Added to Cart'): {isOutOfStock ? 'Out of Stock' : isAdded ? '✓ Added to Cart' : 'Add to Cart'}. Also update className to add a 'button-disabled' or grey styling when out of stock. (c) On the Buy Now button: add disabled={redirecting || isOutOfStock}.

Step 3 — H-4 out-of-stock UI in product-card.tsx: Edit components/product/product-card.tsx. Add: const isOutOfStock = typeof product.stock === 'number' && product.stock <= 0; In the product-visual Link block, after the existing badge {badge && {badge}}, add: {isOutOfStock && Out of Stock}. In the product-actions div, replace with a conditional: {isOutOfStock ? () : ()}.

Step 4 — H-5 show all orders in customer-orders.tsx: Edit components/customer-orders.tsx. Change state: replace 'const [order, setOrder] = useState<CustomerOrder | null>(null)' with 'const [orders, setOrders] = useState<CustomerOrder[]>([])'. Keep a separate 'const [trackedOrder, setTrackedOrder] = useState<CustomerOrder | null>(null)' for the guest-tracked single order (from the OrderTracker path). In loadOrder: change 'if (accountResponse.ok && accountData.orders?.[0]) { setOrder(accountData.orders[0]); return; }' to 'if (accountResponse.ok && accountData.orders?.length) { setOrders(accountData.orders); return; }'. For the guest-tracked order path, set setTrackedOrder(data.order) instead of setOrder. Update the empty/loading check: 'if (!orders.length && !trackedOrder) return <section ... lookup ...>'. In the render: when orders.length > 0, render all orders — the first order (most recent) gets the full detailed view with status timeline; any additional orders are listed below as summary rows showing order number, date, status, and total with a 'View Details' link to /track?order=[orderNumber]. When only trackedOrder exists (guest path), keep the existing single-order detailed view.

Step 5 — L-4 conditional payment heading + checkout redirect URL: (a) Edit components/checkout-wizard.tsx: change 'window.location.assign("/orders")' to 'window.location.assign("/orders?success=true")' in the pay() function after successful payment. (b) Edit components/customer-orders.tsx: add 'import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";' and 'const searchParams = useSearchParams();' and 'const isPostPayment = searchParams.get("success") === "true";'. In the detailed order render, show the 'Payment successful' eyebrow, 'Thank you, ...' h1, and 'Your payment is confirmed...' paragraph only when isPostPayment is true. When isPostPayment is false, show 'Your Orders' as the h1 heading instead.

Step 6 — L-2 clear stale buy-now on unmount: Edit components/checkout-wizard.tsx. Add a new useEffect after the existing useEffect blocks: useEffect(() => { return () => { if (buyNowItem && !orderPlacedRef.current) { clearBuyNowItem(); } }; }, [buyNowItem]); This cleanup runs when the CheckoutWizard unmounts (user navigates away) and clears the buy-now item if payment was not completed. buyNowItem is the value from useState initializer (stable reference); orderPlacedRef.current is false until payment completes.
acceptance_criteria: lib/order-pricing.ts throws an error when product.stock < item.quantity (server-side oversell prevention)
product-detail-view.tsx shows 'Out of Stock' badge and disabled buttons when product.stock === 0
product-card.tsx shows 'Out of Stock' badge on card visual and disabled Add to Cart button when stock === 0
components/customer-orders.tsx renders all orders from the API, not just orders[0]
Payment successful heading only shows when URL has ?success=true query param
checkout-wizard.tsx redirects to /orders?success=true after successful payment
checkout-wizard.tsx clears buy-now item from sessionStorage on unmount if payment was not completed
findings: Build exits 0. Lint: 2 pre-existing errors in checkout-wizard.tsx (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect at lines 111 and 127 — setCities and setQuote calls inside useEffect bodies) were present before this feature and are not introduced by FEAT-002 changes. 4 pre-existing warnings for elements and useMemo dependency arrays also pre-existing. No new errors introduced. orders/page.tsx wrapped in Suspense to satisfy Next.js 14 useSearchParams requirement. pastOrders/pastOrdersList/pastOrderRow CSS classes added to customer-orders.module.css.
